title: The provenance ledger is run-scoped: a previous run's observations do not survive into the next run
note: Two runs share the SAME agent composition (same factory), but each run() gets a fresh run-scoped ledger (fresh traceId). The secret was observed only in run one; run two's sink call EXECUTES because there is no process-wide or cross-run taint ledger. A deny in run two would falsify the documented ceiling.
